svg.text: Calibration is fitted for accuracy, and ECE does not always follow
expected calibration error on the eval split, before → after the fit (logits / T + b) on 500 held-out rows
Red rows are not failures: the per-class bias is selected on held-out NLL and accuracy, not on ECE, so a run can gain accuracy and lose ECE —
headlines goes 0.024 -> 0.036 ECE while gaining 7.5 accuracy points. agnews-nogold has no gold at all, so its fit is made against the teacher's soft
